tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Snowman X400-LS-WC CPU Cooling Fan is a high-performance tower-type air cooler designed for Intel LGA2011 platforms. Equipped with 4 high-efficiency copper heat pipes and dual 90mm RGB fans, this cooler ensures excellent heat dissipation, stable CPU temperatures, and quiet operation. Its modern RGB lighting adds a stylish look to gaming and workstation PC builds, making it an ideal choice for users who need reliable cooling with visual appeal.


Perfect for servers, workstations, and high-load desktop PCs, the Snowman X400-LS-WC delivers balanced performance, durability, and value.


Key Features


  • Compatible with Intel LGA2011 socket
  • Dual 90mm RGB fans for enhanced airflow
  • 4 copper heat pipes for efficient heat transfer
  • Tower-style heatsink design for better cooling
  • Quiet and stable performance under heavy load
  • Durable build quality with modern RGB aesthetics
  • Ideal for gaming PCs, servers, and workstations
